name: ContactCenterDialPadGaCore
description: Enables the supported GA-Core Contact Center feature set for the DialPad voice provider in one step: base orchestration and administration, the workforce (agents and availability), work distribution (queues and routing), the browser soft phone, the agent desktop, real-time updates, preview/manual dialing, and the DialPad Contact Center voice adapter. This is the coherent, certified feature combination for the 'ga-core-dialpad' tenant profile; configure a DialPad provider and your queues, skills, and entry points afterward to route calls.
author: CrestApps
